scenes.heading: Understanding different types of copywriting and content work

sents.d: Understanding different types of copywriting and content work
Different writing niches require different skills and pay differently.

Copywriting (persuasive writing meant to drive an action — sales pages, ads, email sequences) and content writing (informational writing meant to educate or build trust — blog posts, articles) require overlapping but distinct skills and are often priced differently.

Technical writing, UX writing (the words inside software interfaces), and ghostwriting each have their own conventions and client expectations worth understanding before marketing yourself broadly as 'a writer.'

Specializing in one or two of these categories, rather than offering all of them generally, usually makes marketing and pricing clearer, and lets you build a stronger portfolio in that specific area faster.

take: Pick one or two kinds of writing to specialize in.
